intervals.label: collaboration
intervals.note: True formation date not sourced; start is a lower bound taken from the start of MicroBooNE neutrino data taking in October 2015 (the collaboration must have existed by then). Detector data taking ended in 2021 (status 'completed' on the experiment entity), but the collaboration continued to publish analyses, e.g. the December 2025 Nature sterile-neutrino search; left 'active' since no dissolution is sourced.
intervals.quote: The experiment first started collecting neutrino data in October 2015.

summary.plain: The team that built and ran the MicroBooNE liquid-argon detector at Fermilab, and continues to analyse its data to search for new kinds of neutrinos.
summary.technical: Collaboration operating the MicroBooNE LArTPC on the Fermilab Booster Neutrino Beam; data taking October 2015-2021, with continued publication of sterile-neutrino and cross-section analyses afterward.
